facts.text: The Roo Advantage Scholarship ensures tuition and fees are met for full-time, Pell-eligible Missouri and Kansas residents.

sources.title: Roo Advantage Scholarship - Scholarships and Grants Listing - Financial Aid and Scholarships | UMKC
sources.quote: The award ensures tuition and fees are met for full-time, Pell-eligible Missouri and Kansas residents who file the FAFSA by April 1 for Fall admits and Dec. 1 for Spring admits.
